account_id.description: JupiterOne account ID to create resources in

api_key.description: API Key used to make requests to the JupiterOne APIs

region.description: region used for generating the GraphQL endpoint url. If not provided defaults to 'us'

name.description: The name of the account parameter. Must be unique. Must contain no spaces, just alphanumeric characters, and underscores.

secret.description: Whether or not the value can be retrieved from the api. Defaults to false. If it is secret then it cannot be retrieved through the API and will show as changed for every terraform plan.

value.description: The value of the account parameter. This string value gets parsed based on the value_type.

value_type.description: The type of the value. Possible values: string, number, boolean.

catalog.description: The catalog this control belongs to (e.g. CIS Controls v8)

identifier.description: An identifier for the control used for sorting (e.g. IDAM3.5)

owner.description: The owner of the control, represented by a user email

requirement_ids.description: List of control framework requirement IDs to associate with this control

resource_group_id.description: The resource group ID to scope the control to

state.description: The lifecycle state of the control. Must be DRAFT or LIVE on creation; can be transitioned to REVIEW or RETIRED via update.

name.description: The name of the control framework

resource_group_id.description: The resource group ID to scope the framework to

framework_id.description: The ID of the control framework this requirement belongs to

identifier.description: A unique identifier for the requirement

section.description: The section this requirement belongs to

block.description: A requirement belonging to a control framework.

control_id.description: The ID of the control this test belongs to

name.description: The name of the control test

results_are.description: Whether query results indicate GOOD or BAD compliance

block.description: A control test containing a J1QL query that evaluates control compliance.

custom_definition_type.description: Type of custom definition. Must be either 'custom' or 'cft'

description.description: Description of the custom integration definition

docs_web_link.description: Documentation web link for the integration

icon.description: Icon for the integration. Must be one of the preloaded icon names like 'custom_earth', 'custom_jupiter', etc. See custom integration definition UI for a full list of icons.

id.description: Unique identifier for the custom integration definition

integration_type.description: Type of integration. Should be unique across JupiterOne. Should be a kebab-case string (lowercase with hyphens), e.g. 'jupiterone-example-integration'

name.description: Name of the custom integration definition

value_type.description: The value type of the parameter.

framework_type.description: Whether this is a standard, benchmark, or questionnaire

scope_filters.description: JSON encoded filters for scoping the framework.

version.description: Version of the framework itself (not an J1 API version)

web_link.description: A URL for referencing additional information about the framework

block.description: A custom compliance standard, benchmark, or questionnaire.

group_id.description: The internal ID of the framework group this item belongs to

collector_pool_id.description: The ID of the collector pool.

config.description: The configuration for the integration instance as a JSON string.

description.description: The description of the integration instance.

id.description: The unique identifier of the integration instance.

name.description: The name of the integration instance.

polling_interval.description: The polling interval for the integration instance.

polling_interval_cron_expression.description: The cron expression for the polling interval as a JSON string.

source_integration_instance_id.description: The ID of the source integration instance.

policy_item_id.description: The internal ID of the policy item this control is related to, if any

web_link.description: A URL for referencing additional information about the LibraryItem

polling_interval.description: Frequency of automated question evaluation. Defaults to ONE_DAY.

show_trend.description: Whether to enable daily trend data collection. Defaults to false.

name.description: The name of the resource group.

can_create.description: Whether the subject can create the resource.

can_delete.description: Whether the subject can delete the resource.

can_read.description: Whether the subject can read the resource.

can_update.description: Whether the subject can update the resource.

resource_area.description: The resource area that these permissions will be applied to. Possible values: rule, dashboard, integration, collector.

resource_id.description: The ID of the resource that these permissions will be applied to (e.g. rule ID, resource group ID, *).

resource_type.description: The resource type that these permissions will be applied to. Possible values: resource_group, *, rule, dashboard, integration, collector.

subject_id.description: The ID of the subject that the resource permissions will be applied to (e.g. group ID).

subject_type.description: The type of the subject that the resource permissions will be applied to. Possible values: group, token.

id.description: Unique id that identifies the rule

label_value.description: Value of the label, which is represented in TF as a string but will be treated as string, number or boolean in the application

labels.description: Comma separated list of labelName/labelValue pairs to apply to the rule.

name.description: Name of the rule, which is unique to each account.

when.description: A JSON object that specifies the condition to evaluate before executing the actions. Required when `trigger_on_new_only` is enabled.

operations.description: Actions that are executed when a corresponding condition is met.

outputs.description: Names of properties that can be used throughout the rule evaluation process and will be included in each record of a rule evaluation. (e.g. queries.query0.total)

polling_interval.description: Frequency of automated rule evaluation. Defaults to ONE_DAY.

question_id.description: Specifies the ID of a question to be used in rule evaluation.

resource_group_id.description: Specifies the ID of a resource group for the rule to be added to

spec_version.description: Rule evaluation specification version in the case of breaking changes.

tags.description: Comma separated list of tags to apply to the rule.

templates.description: Optional key/value pairs of template name to template

trigger_on_new_only.description: When enabled, rule actions will only be triggered for new entities that match the rule query. At least one `when` condition must be defined in the rule's operations for this setting to be respected.

version.description: Computed current version of the rule. Incremented each time the rule is updated.

block.description: Contains properties related to queries used in the rule evaluation.
